docs.text:
Narasimhachar’s monograph on the Keśava temple of Somanāthapur, the Hoysaḷa temple of the thirteenth century, with its architecture, sculptures and inscriptions (Bangalore, 1919). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Kesava Temple At Somanathapur Vol. 2 · Narasimhachar, R. · 1919, 85 scanned pages. Published 1919; R. Narasimhachar died 1936; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
